title: Content Writer (Portuguese) - 53457
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Content Writer to create and refine content used in workflows, training data, and scenario-based evaluations for large language models (LLMs). You will help build realistic content samples, review AI-generated outputs, and ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create and edit content across formats such as articles, guides, workflows, and scenarios.
  • Recreate real-world content workflows for AI evaluation.
  • Review AI outputs for quality, accuracy, and adherence to guidelines.
  • Provide feedback and annotations to support LLM improvement.
  • Collaborate with product and AI teams to align content with operational needs.


Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience as a Content Writer, Copywriter, or Technical Writer.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify content gaps or inconsistencies.
  • Familiarity with documentation or workflow tools (e.g., Confluence, Notion, Zendesk, Jira).
  • Excellent written communication skills.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : at least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 1 month


Evaluation Process :

  • Shortlisted candidates will be reviewed by our team internally and shortlisted candidates will be reached out for onboarding.

title: Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
Position Summary

We are looking for a Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist to join a fast-growing real estate startup in the U.S. This is a hybrid role that combines helpdesk support, HubSpot operations, outbound sales assistance, and light marketing support.

The ideal candidate has strong experience managing support tickets, excellent communication skills, deep familiarity with HubSpot, and the ability to multitask across customer support, RevOps, and sales processes in a fast-paced startup environment.


Key Responsibilities

Customer Support & Helpdesk (40–50%)

  • Serve as the primary responder for inbound support tickets from users.
  • Monitor, triage, and resolve issues through HubSpot Service Hub.
  • Maintain strong response/resolution times with empathetic, professional communication.
  • Document common issues and build internal resources or playbooks.


HubSpot Operations & Administration (20–25%)

  • Manage and optimize workflows, pipelines, automations, and ticket management across HubSpot.
  • Maintain data accuracy for contacts, deals, and support tickets.
  • Support setup and QA of new sequences, processes, and automation in HubSpot.
  • Pull basic reports on sales activity, ticket volume, and marketing performance.


Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting (20–25%)

  • Execute outbound email campaigns and sequences targeting prospects such as real estate agents or brokers.
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads following defined playbooks.
  • Set calls and demos for the sales team.
  • Track all activities and updates inside HubSpot.


Marketing Support (5–10%)

  • Assist with email marketing campaigns, list building, and segmentation.
  • Support basic digital marketing tasks as needed.


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of customer support or helpdesk experience (B2B SaaS experience preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including:
  • Service/Operations Hub (tickets, workflows, automation)
  • Sales Hub (pipelines, deals, sequences, tasks)
  • Proven success managing support tickets as a core responsibility.
  • Experience supporting outbound sales workflows, sequences, and appointment setting.
  • Familiarity with email marketing or digital campaign support.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with shifting demands.
  • Availability to work 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM MST .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in real estate or PropTech industries.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, ClickUp, and Canva.
  • Experience building support documentation, macros, or knowledge base articles.
  • Track record of improving support metrics or boosting outbound meeting conversions.


What We Offer

  • Fully Remote Position! Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and skill development.
  • Take Your Local Holidays: We respect your cultural and personal commitments.
  • Impact: Join a mission-driven U.S. startup where your work directly enhances customer experience and revenue operations.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

title: Technical Lead Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Technical Lead Developer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

kills: B2B domain expertise, Salesforce, strong communication, process improvement

JD:

  • Act as the primary SPOC , coordinating resources and managing priorities across teams.
  • Drive service reviews, escalate issues, and ensure timely resolution for critical business processes.
  • Suggest and implement process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and governance.
  • Analyze KPIs and reporting metrics to identify trends and recommend corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align technology solutions with business objectives and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Expertise in Salesforce Configurations using Workflows, Process builders, Flows, Roles, Enterprise Territory Management, Security Controls, Reports and Dashboards and Sharing rules.
  • Experience in Administration, Configuration, Implementation and experience with Salesforce platform.
  • Experience in Salesforce Customization, Security Access, Workflow Approvals, Data Validation, data utilities.
  • Expertise in SFDC Development using Apex Language, Visual Force pages, Classes, Controllers, Triggers, Indexes, Web Services, Components, Tabs, Apex Web services, Custom Objects, Reports, Analytic Snapshots and Dashboards, Profiles, Creating Roles, Page Layouts, Org - Wide default, Sharing rules, Work Flows
  • Experience in Sales Cloud, Field Service and CPQ, Ant Migration tool, Standard and custom controllers, Data Loader, Force.com, Eclipse IDE Plug-in, VS Code, Work Flow-Approval, Custom objects, Custom tabs, Email service, Html, Web-service (REST and SOAP)
  • Experience in debugging the code for troubleshooting the issues


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Data Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: Full Time

Compensation: Competitive hourly rate, commensurate with experience



About Design Manager

Design Manager (+DesignSpec) is a leading provider of project management and accounting software tailored specifically for interior design firms. For over 30 years, we’ve helped thousands of designers run more efficient, profitable businesses with our cloud-based platform that integrates purchasing, budgeting, time tracking, and client communication in one seamless solution. As we grow, we're investing heavily in our data infrastructure to enhance product capabilities and improve client outcomes.



About the Role


We’re seeking a skilled Data Engineer to support our product and technology team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines, analyzing data, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. You'll be the first and only dedicated data analytics team member , so we’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who is comfortable operating independently, defining structure, and solving complex data challenges.



What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes


  • Clean, validate, and structure raw data from various sources to ensure data quality and usability


  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decision-making


  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate key performance metrics to stakeholders


  • Work cross-functionally with teams (e.g., finance, operations, marketing) to define data needs and solve business problems using data


  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand and meet data requirements


  • Develop data models and schemas for analytics and reporting


  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability


  • Support the design and implementation of a modern data warehouse architecture


  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security best practices are followed


  • Work with third-party APIs and internal tools to extract, transform, and load data


  • Demonstrate an entrepreneurial, self-starter attitude as the inaugural data analytics hire




Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field


  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with Python or another scripting language


  • Experience analyzing large datasets and generating insights that drive business impact


  • Familiarity with dashboarding and analytics platforms such as Mode, Power BI, or similar


  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)


  • Experience with ETL tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Fivetran) and data pipeline orchestration


  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and data modeling


  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills


  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal oversight




Nice to Have


  • Experience in SaaS or B2B software environments


  • Exposure to finance or accounting domains




Why Join Us

  • Competitive hourly compensation


  • High-impact role with significant autonomy and visibility


  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of data and analytics at a growing SaaS company


  • Collaborative and mission-driven team environment


  • Possibility for contract extension or full-time conversion based on performance and business needs

  • Work cross-functionally with teams (e.g., finance, operations, marketing) to define data needs and solve business problems using data


  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand and meet data requirements


  • Develop data models and schemas for analytics and reporting


  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability


  • Support the design and implementation of a modern data warehouse architecture


  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security best practices are followed


  • Work with third-party APIs and internal tools to extract, transform, and load data


  • Demonstrate an entrepreneurial, self-starter attitude as the inaugural data analytics hire




Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field


  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with Python or another scripting language


  • Experience analyzing large datasets and generating insights that drive business impact


  • Familiarity with dashboarding and analytics platforms such as Mode, Power BI, or similar


  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)


  • Experience with ETL tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Fivetran) and data pipeline orchestration


  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and data modeling


  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills


  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal oversight




Nice to Have


  • Experience in SaaS or B2B software environments


  • Exposure to finance or accounting domains




Why Join Us

  • Competitive hourly compensation


  • High-impact role with significant autonomy and visibility


  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of data and analytics at a growing SaaS company


  • Collaborative and mission-driven team environment


  • Possibility for contract extension or full-time conversion based on performance and business needs

title: Arqueólogo
description:
A Ecoplan está com uma oportunidade para Arqueólogo (a) atuar diretamente em atividades de monitoramento arqueológico em frentes de pavimentação. Buscamos alguém comprometido, responsável e disposto a vivenciar uma experiência imersiva em campo.


Responsabilidades:

- Monitoramento arqueológico em frentes de serviço de pavimentação.

- Diálogo técnico com encarregados e engenheiros.

- Registros fotográficos e elaboração de descrições das atividades.

- Identificação e comunicação de possíveis materiais arqueológicos.

- Atividades de educação patrimonial com comunidades lindeiras.

- Elaboração de relatórios mensais e semestrais.

- Apoio na elaboração de ofícios e comunicações com o IPHAN.


Requisitos:

* Formação em Arqueologia.

* Experiência em monitoramento arqueológico de empreendimentos lineares. (desejável)

* Ter vivência prévia em alojamento (desejável).

* CNH B (desejável).


Local e Modelo de Trabalho:

- Disponibilidade para morar no alojamento em Calçoene/AP.

- Retorno para casa a cada 4 meses por 10 dias (com passagens custeadas).

- Possibilidade de passar finais de semana em Macapá a cada 15 dias, com alojamento disponível.

- Alimentação no alojamento é custeada pela empresa.

- Atuação em campo com suporte de equipe e infraestrutura local.

- Contratação PJ

description:

- Desenvolver software utilizando as competências técnicas de programação, banco de dados e testes de software

title: Proprietário do produto
description:
DESCRIÇÃO 

Como Product Owner, você será responsável por conduzir processos de descoberta, ideação e validação das funcionalidades do produto, transformando necessidades em soluções claras e priorizadas. Atuará diretamente com o time de desenvolvimento, garantindo a evolução contínua do produto, alinhamento com stakeholders e entrega de valor aos usuários. 


RESPONSABILIDADES 


  • Entendimento dos requisitos/necessidades das áreas de negócio; 
  • Priorizar e manter o backlog de desenvolvimento de forma a otimizar a execução das tarefas e os incrementos no produto; 
  • Acompanhar cronogramas e roadmaps, alinhado à expectativa dos clientes e usuários; 
  • Definir KPIs/OKRs específicos de produtos entregues e comunicar o monitoramento regular aos stakeholders; 
  • Trabalhar com o líder técnico para entender quais as entregas técnicas necessárias; 
  • Definir incrementos de valor na plataforma; 
  • Conduzir as demandas desde a sua identificação e planejamento até a sua efetiva aplicação; 
  • Escrever os requisitos de desenvolvimento e definir seus critérios de aceitação junto com o time; 
  • Orientar o time de desenvolvimento na execução e entrega das demandas, sempre buscando o alinhamento com o negócio e o produto; 
  • Participar de demonstrações do produto;  
  • Validar sistemas e soluções entregues pelo time desenvolvimento; 
  • Atuar junto com o líder técnico, identificando possíveis atrasos nas entregas e definindo mudanças de prioridades; 
  • Manter-se em constante atualização com as melhores práticas do mercado, trazendo sugestões e novas soluções. 

REQUISITOS 


  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de produtos B2C; 
  • Experiência na escrita de requisitos de desenvolvimento de software; 
  • Experiência na gestão de backlog de desenvolvimento; 
  • Conhecimentos de técnicas de priorização do product backlog; 
  • Familiaridade com processos de discovery; 
  • Vivência em times de desenvolvimento ágil; 
  • Habilidade de negociação e relacionamento com desenvolvedores, usuários e partes interessadas; 
  • Background técnico na área de programação; 
  • Conhecimentos em Figma ou ferramentas similares; 


DIFERENCIAIS 


  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções para maquininhas de pagamento; 
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções comerciais para o varejo e/ou marketplace; 
  • Conhecimento básicos de UX e UI; 
  • Certificação Product Owner (PSPO ou CSP);

title: Network Implementation Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Network Operations and Implementation Engineer – LAN/WLAN

Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled and motivated L3 Network Engineer provide Level 3 network support and to implement LAN and WLAN infrastructure at sites across the North and South America. The ideal candidate will hold at least a CCNA certification, possess strong experience in configuring Cisco network switches and wireless access points, and can manage third-party wiring vendors effectively. This role requires a commitment to extensive travel, flexibility to work off-hours and weekends, and a focus on delivering high-quality network solutions in a dynamic environment. Trilingual in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

Key Responsibilities:

- Configure switches and wireless access points.

- Perform site assessments to evaluate current network infrastructure and develop action plans for equipment refresh.

- Work collaboratively with wiring vendors to oversee and ensure proper cabling and device installations and terminations meet project standards.

- Manage and troubleshoot network issues during the deployment and provide Level 3 hyper care support as needed.

- Document network configurations, topologies, and changes to maintain accurate records.

- Adhere to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.

- Travel extensively (up to 25%) to various sites across South America, Mexico, the United States and Canada, including weekends and off-hours work as necessary.

Qualifications:

- Minimum Certification: CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate), CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional) preferred.

- Proven experience in deploying and managing network devices, including Cisco and Juniper switches and wireless access points.

- Strong knowledge of LAN/WLAN networking protocols.

- Familiarity with cabling standards and experience managing wiring vendors.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in fast-paced environments.

- Strong communication skills to interact effectively with team members, vendors, and stakeholders.

- Availability to travel internationally, extensively (up to 25%) and work weekends or during off-hours as required.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que

oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Hey, Dev, check the opportunity we have here at Brick Abode!


About Brick Abode


We are a software development company that serves clients from multiple countries around the world, with differing technological needs. Therefore, we value a good computer science base.


Contractors with a solid understanding of the basic building blocks of today’s technology are really welcome and thrive at Brick Abode.


People here are given autonomy, not put into a box to work only on one thing. They are in touch with the business needs of our clients, sometimes communicating with them directly.


We challenge ourselves to learn new things and go outside our comfort zone. Candidates who are up to the challenge will have an amazing career with us.


If you feel that your values fit with Brick Abode culture, check below for further details about this Position.


What kind of professional are we looking for?


We’re looking for a responsible and proactive professional who can navigate between technology and business contexts with ease, feel comfortable in fast-paced environments, and have great communication skills.

Our team is Brazil and USA-based, and communication is in English. The position is fully remote.



What do I need to have to apply for this position?


  • Python (with strong data handling experience): ETL pipelines, familiarity with DataFrames (Pandas or similar)
  • PostgreSQL (loading, validation, filtering)
  • Familiarity with the AWS Cloud ecosystem
  • CI/CD and code hygiene for data pipelines
  • Machine Learning
  • Fluent English
  • An academic background (MSc or PhD) will also be a plus



As Contractor (PJ), you will have:


  • Competitive compensation (in Reais - R$)
  • Work with international clients with international standards
  • Opportunity to grow as a leader
  • Possibility to move between teams
  • Speak in English with your coworkers
  • 2 weeks of paid leave per year
  • National holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid marriage leave
  • Working with a company that cares about our people and their personal growth
  • All expenses paid for training, conferences, and online courses
  • Remote work
  • Health Care Plan - Online


If you are passionate about technology and have a strong desire to work on cutting-edge projects, we encourage you to apply for this position!


Submit your CV to make sure it contains your LinkedIn and GitHub accounts.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

title: Desenvolvedor de .NET sênior (Sustentação)
description:
Requisitos

Obrigatório:

Experiência com .NET (Projetos de sustentação).

O profissional N2 .NET Sênior deve apresentar competências comportamentais avançadas que sustentem sua atuação técnica, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, comunicação estratégica e capacidade de liderar tecnicamente dentro da equipe.


Responsabilidades

Comunicação Técnica Assertiva

Demonstra habilidade em comunicar soluções, riscos e decisões técnicas de forma clara e acessível, facilitando o entendimento entre equipes técnicas, produto e negócio.


Liderança Técnica Colaborativa

Atua como referência para o time, apoiando desenvolvedores menos experientes, promovendo boas práticas de desenvolvimento e contribuindo para decisões arquiteturais.


Autonomia e Proatividade

Conduz atividades complexas com independência, identifica riscos antecipadamente e propõe melhorias que impactam positivamente a performance, segurança e eficiência das aplicações .NET.


Resolução de Problemas Complexos

Analisa incidentes e cenários avançados, identifica causas raiz e propõe soluções escaláveis, robustas e de alto desempenho.


Gestão de Prioridades

Administra diversas demandas simultâneas, garantindo organização, foco em SLA e alinhamento com requisitos técnicos e de negócio.


Adaptabilidade Tecnológica

Responde rapidamente a mudanças tecnológicas, novos frameworks e atualizações do ecossistema .NET, aplicando-as de forma estratégica para contribuir com a evolução da arquitetura.


Senso de Dono (Ownership)

Demonstra responsabilidade integral pelas entregas, incluindo qualidade de código, estabilidade em produção e confiabilidade das integrações.


Colaboração Multidisciplinar

Trabalha de forma integrada com times de QA, DevOps, Arquitetura, Infraestrutura e Produto, garantindo sinergia, transparência e entregas alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio.


Orientação ao Cliente

Atua com postura consultiva, compreendendo necessidades do cliente interno/externo e garantindo soluções funcionais, eficientes e aderentes ao contexto da empresa.


Melhoria Contínua

Busca continuamente evoluir processos, automatizar tarefas, aprimorar pipelines e elevar o padrão de qualidade do ambiente .NET e da equipe.

Localidade: Qualquer lugar do Brasil.

Vaga 100% remota.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Analista Cloud Azure - pleno/sênior | Comunicação em Espanhol fluente

Remoto (Brasil) ou Híbrido (SP/Região)


Buscamos um(a) especialista em Microsoft Azure com mentalidade DevOps/SRE e Espanhol avançado/fluente para atuar em projetos internacionais.

Será a peça-chave na sustentação e evolução de uma infraestrutura de nuvem crítica. Sua missão será garantir alta disponibilidade , otimizar custos e acelerar a entrega de valor através da automação.


Principais responsabilidades:


Você não será apenas um executor, mas um agente de transformação, colaborando globalmente.

Ser a referência na resolução de incidentes e problemas complexos no ambiente Azure.

Desenvolver, manter e aprimorar pipelines robustos no Azure DevOps, garantindo entregas rápidas e seguras.

Automatizar o provisionamento de recursos em escala utilizando Terraform.

Administrar e otimizar ambientes de Docker e orquestração com Kubernetes.

Gerenciar e aplicar práticas de FinOps para garantir a eficiência no consumo de recursos Azure.

Participar ativamente de discussões técnicas, documentação e suporte em Espanhol com times internacionais.


Requisitos essenciais:


Nossos filtros de seleção serão rigorosos para garantir o sucesso mútuo:

Obrigatório ter espanhol fluente/avançado para comunicação diária e reuniões com equipes de outros países.

Experiência sólida com Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS e Serverless).

Proficiência em Azure DevOps, Git e construção de pipelines de CI/CD.

Conhecimento prático e experiência com Terraform .

Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes .

Conhecimento em Linux e Windows Server .

Familiaridade com processos de ITIL/ITSM .

Formação superior completa em áreas de Tecnologia (ex: Ciência da Computação, Engenharia).


Diferenciais:

  • Possuir certificações técnicas Azure (Ex: AZ-104, AZ-400).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Ex: Datadog).
  • Habilidade de scripting (PowerShell, Bash ou Python).


***


Pacote de benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico de ponta.
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).
  • Seguro de Vida e Auxílio Creche.
  • Parcerias educacionais (idiomas e ensino superior).


Etapas do processo seletivo:

Bate-papo (RH): Alinhamento de perfil, expectativas e fit cultural/comportamental.

Entrevista técnica: Aprofundamento técnico e Teste Prático (se necessário) .


Modalidade de trabalho:

  • Full Remoto para candidatos de fora de São Paulo/Região.
  • Híbrido para São Paulo e arredores.

Horário: Segunda a sexta, das 8h às 17h.

title: Executivo de Soluções Financeiras
description:
Esta vaga é aberta para pessoas com deficiência (PCD) e não PCD.


O que o profissional realizará:

  • Identificar oportunidades e prospectar clientes para soluções de cash management;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, auxiliando o cliente na tomada de decisão sobre a melhor forma de gerir e circular seu dinheiro;
  • Analisar o fluxo de caixa e as necessidades de movimentação financeira dos clientes, propondo soluções personalizadas para otimizar processos e reduzir custos operacionais;
  • Apresentar opções de aplicação e utilização estratégica do numerário, de acordo com as soluções (ex.: cofre inteligente, gestão de depósitos, antecipação de valores via parceiros, etc.);
  • Participar de reuniões de performance e planejamento junto aos clientes, apresentando resultados e oportunidades de expansão;
  • Acompanhar a implementação de novos serviços e tecnologias financeiras oferecidas pela empresa;
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho, satisfação dos clientes, metas e pipeline do time de vendas, propondo ações de melhoria contínua para otimizar os resultados.

O que precisa para trabalhar conosco:

  • Superior completo;
  • Experiência com relacionamento comercial junto a instituições financeiras para produtos de tecnologia ou áreas correlatas;
  • CHN B
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;


Benefícios

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Auxílio academia
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale-refeição
  • Vale-transporte

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineers


Breakthrough Talent is currently supporting a leading data business build a brand new data platform to support a modern data mesh organisation. They work with national and global clients across data, software and digital consulting, and they are now looking for a Data Infrastructure Engineer to help build and scale their next generation platform.


This role suits someone who enjoys owning infrastructure, building reusable solutions, and supporting data teams with analytics and AI ready environments.


The Role


As a Data Engineer you will design, build and maintain the core infrastructure that enables data processing, analytics, data science and data management across the business.


You will work in a multi account and multi region AWS environment that follows zero trust and least privilege principles. Infrastructure as Code and CI CD will be central to how you operate, alongside continuous improvement and strong governance.


What You Will Do


  • Build and maintain cloud based infrastructure using Cloud Formation and SAM
  • Design and implement data processing environments using AWS services such as Glue, EMR, Sagemaker, Redshift, Aurora and Snowflake
  • Build data processing pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark, Spark, Lambda, Step Functions and Apache Airflow
  • Monitor performance, cost and security of the data platform
  • Apply strong data governance and access control for sensitive data
  • Collaborate with multiple teams to support the wider data platform strategy


What You Need


  • Six years or more experience in a Data Engineering or Data Infrastructure role
  • Strong experience building data architectures in AWS
  • Solid coding skills in Python and SQL, Golang
  • Strong Cloud Formation knowledge
  • Experience working with relational databases such as Postgres or Redshift
  • Good coding discipline including documentation, unit testing and version control
  • Experience with Git and CI CD tools such as GitLab
  • Worked in Agile teams and ceremonies
  • Strong problem solving skills and excellent communication


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Jira or similar project management tools
  • Experience with Snowflake
  • Spatial data processing experience


If you would like to learn more about the role, please reach out to Jake Denman at Breakthrough Talent.

title: Operations Analytics
description:
We're looking for a Operations Analytics 100% remote in Brazil


Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Operations Analytics professional to deliver high-impact insights that support our end-to-end operations. In this role, you will work closely with teams across inventory, logistics, retail, and customer service, while partnering with technology and finance stakeholders. You’ll engage with nearly all aspects of a growing business to measure performance, identify opportunities, and drive alignment toward the most impactful operational improvements.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze, understand, and quantify key operational efficiency metrics.
  • Design, implement, and report on item-level data throughout receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows.
  • Provide daily reporting and product-health measurements to support business decision-making.
  • Communicate insights clearly and effectively to partner teams and leadership.
  • Collaborate with operations analysts to optimize processes and uncover opportunities for growth.


Minimum Requirements:

  • 5+ years of analytics experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL.
  • 5+ years working with BI tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, Looker, etc.
  • Strong ability to translate practical business problems into technical solutions.
  • Proven experience delivering time-sensitive strategic projects involving methodology development, analysis, recommendations, and executive presentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous environments.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in eCommerce or logistics industries.

title: Multidisciplinary Designer
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa talentosa, experiente e comprometida para integrar nosso time.


Somos a commcepta, um estúdio de Design Management sediado em Curitiba com atuação global. Um time de talentos multidisciplinares com o propósito de superar a si mesmo a cada novo desafio. Somos membros, parte do Advisory Council e premiados pelo Design Management Institute (DMI), além de outras alianças estratégicas que somam conhecimento e reconhecem nossa atuação ao longo dos nossos mais de 25 anos. Mergulhamos fundo em pesquisa, conceituamos a solução para o problema e aplicamos Design em busca de um desenvolvimento sustentável, colaborativo e orgânico.


✏️ Sua função

Seu papel como Multidisciplinary Designer será somar na tradução daquilo que encontramos e validamos em pesquisa, conectados ao conceito central do projeto e integrados à estratégia do nosso cliente. Tudo isso alinhado ao nosso propósito de superar a nós mesmos em tudo o que fazemos.

A profundidade do nosso pensamento e a imersão no cliente são premissas do nosso trabalho. Primeiro, questionamos o problema, para depois buscar as possíveis soluções. Por isso, as possibilidades são múltiplas e permeiam todos os pontos de contato do público com a marca. A versatilidade do seu trabalho para elaborar diferentes materiais e sua habilidade em lidar com diversos segmentos contam muitos pontos para este papel.


✨ Nossas expectativas


Esperamos que todo(a) commcepter:

  • Traga novas ideias, some e vá além do “briefing”
  • Seja caprichoso, organizado e tenha atenção aos detalhes
  • Saiba ouvir e trabalhar colaborativamente
  • Concorde que design é mais do que layout e conceito não é “blá blá”
  • Goste de trabalhar com diferentes projetos, dos simples aos mais complexos
  • Busque aprender e se desenvolver com novas experiências e situações desafiadoras
  • Tenha uma visão ampla sem perder o foco nas operações do dia a dia
  • Seja comprometido e tenha vontade de crescer


Como Multidisciplinary Designer, esperamos que você:

  • Desenhe peças incríveis que deixem todo mundo orgulhoso
  • Seja hábil na criação de composições visualmente atraentes e cheias de significado
  • Seja inovador na criação de campanhas e comunicação de marca
  • Saiba conduzir uma boa pesquisa, conectando referências e autoridades do tema
  • Tenha um bom conhecimento do pacote Adobe (InDesign, Illustrator e Photoshop)
  • Tenha um nível de inglês intermediário para lidar com projetos globais


Especialidades desejadas:

  • Ter uma boa redação para a criação de chamadas e conteúdos
  • Ter habilidades de composição de storyboards e de animações / motion graphics
  • E/ou se interessar por UX-UI Design, saber criar e prototipar interfaces


Key Words: Multidisciplinary Design / Graphic Design / Brand Design / Visual Design / Brand Communication / Digital Design / Content Design / Design Research / Motion Design


Híbrido - Curitiba (Remote First)


É importante você saber que nossa forma de trabalho principal é remota, por isso contamos que você esteja disposto a trabalhar em casa. Buscamos pessoas que moram em Curitiba e região para encontros presenciais em nossa sede, quando necessário.

title: Software Engineer (Murex)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Murex Developer to join our team, supporting strategic initiatives within the financial sector. The role begins as fully remote , with the expectation of relocation to Portugal after an agreed transition period. You will work closely with multicultural teams, contributing to the enhancement and stability of the Murex MX.3 platform.


Responsibilities

  • Develop, customize, and maintain components and configurations within Murex MX.3 , across modules such as Trading, Risk, Collateral, and Back Office.
  • Build and enhance workflows, simulation views, formulas, and MxML Exchange interfaces.
  • Design and maintain integrations with internal and external systems (REST, SOAP, MQ, APIs, ETL, etc.).
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents, ensuring system stability and performance.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, QA, and project teams to gather requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Support release cycles, functional testing, regression testing, and UAT phases.
  • Maintain compliance with technical standards, documentation, and governance processes.


Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Murex MX.3 (configuration, development, or integration).
  • Solid knowledge of Datamart, MxML Exchange, Workflows, Simulation Views , and other core Murex components.
  • Strong programming skills: Java, SQL, Shell Script , and ideally Python.
  • Experience with system integrations, middleware, or messaging platforms.
  • Good understanding of financial instruments, especially derivatives (FX, IRD, Fixed Income, Equities, Commodities).
  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Willingness and eligibility to relocate to Portugal after the initial remote period.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience working with major banks or large international financial institutions.
  • Knowledge of DevOps methodologies and tools (CI/CD, Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum .
  • Murex certifications or experience with MX.2 → MX.3 migrations.

Desired Profile

  • Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving ability.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in remote and multicultural environments.
  • Proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and capable of working under pressure.
  • Motivated to engage in a long-term role involving relocation.

What We Offer

  • Remote work during the initial phase.
  • Support and guidance for future relocation to Portugal .
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Opportunity to work on complex, high-impact financial systems.
  • Multicultural work environment and professional growth opportunities.

title: DevOps Pleno - GCP
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (GCP) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.

title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
description:
We are Software Mind, an awesome team of engineers who are ready to ramp up any top-notch company’s projects! Our aim? To always be one step ahead. Become part of a multicultural company in constant growth with an excellent work environment certified by Great Place To Work!


Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Engineer to join one of our USA Clients' engineering teams which is building solutions to dramatically change the way people purchase their daily goods, providing the modern-day solution to meet customer’s immediate everyday needs with products ranging from snacks and ice cream to household goods and beer, at the click of a button. If you enjoy working with cutting-edge technologies in a fast-paced environment this opportunity is for you!

Expectations - the experience you need

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science (or related field)
  • 8+ years of experience in a senior engineering role with increasing responsibility, focused on Backend Development & Integrations.
  • Experience acting in a tech lead capacity for a small team without direction.
  • Proficiency with SQL, Postgres, NodeJS, Java, and/or Go.
  • Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and their application in building.
  • Data intensive applications that process high velocity data (millions of transactions) or high-volume data (transactions impacting millions of records).
  • Experience using Terraform, Pulumi, Helm, GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with SQL data analysis (Snowflake/BigQuery), some familiarity of data pipelines.
  • Experience with message-based, async processing.
  • Experience with JavaScript & SPA technology in a production setting (e.g. Vue, React).
  • Public cloud experience in a production setting (Azure preferred).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Responsibilities - What you'll do

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality software solutions.
  • Implement system and data monitors to ensure the correctness of the business process.
  • Contribute to multiple team-wide business and tech objectives (beyond just the goals assigned).
  • Lead cross-functional projects in an agile environment; participate in planning, Scope, decompose, and organize projects for multiple teammates.
  • Delegate tasks and coordinate teammates to bring those projects to completion with minimal oversight.
  • Generate time estimates with reasonable accuracy to help determine project timelines.
  • Support standard development practices across your team, including idiomatic syntax, design patterns, and Testing/Quality Practice.
  • Provide primary operational support and engineering for multiple large distributed software applications.
  • Integrate with existing REST APIs, author new APIs, and expose the data to the frontend.

Our offer – professional development, personal growth

  • Educational resources
  • Flexible schedule and work from anywhere
  • Referral Program
  • Supportive and chill atmosphere

We are accepting applications from LATAM countries

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
A Exadel está procurando um Desenvolvedor Fullstack de Nível Intermediário (Java + Angular+ Quarkus) . Este profissional contribuirá tanto nas tarefas de desenvolvimento back-end quanto front-end, enquanto também desempenha um papel na garantia da qualidade do produto por meio de testes e validação. O foco será na entrega de recursos robustos, validação de integrações FIX, construção de interfaces de usuário e suporte a testes automatizados, tudo em estreita colaboração com a equipe sênior.


Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e manter aplicações usando Java + Quarkus no back-end e Angular no front-end. Entregar funcionalidades, correções de bugs e melhorias na interface com atenção ao desempenho e à usabilidade. Criar, executar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, de integração, ponta a ponta). Garantir a qualidade do código e contribuir para manter uma alta cobertura de testes em toda a pilha. Colaborar em atividades de QA, validando tanto requisitos técnicos quanto de negócios. Fornecer suporte na resolução de problemas de aplicações em produção de baixa/média complexidade. Trabalhar em um ambiente ágil e colaborativo, interagindo com equipes de negócios, produtos e tecnologia.


Experiência prática com Java 11+ e Quarkus (RESTEasy, Panache, MicroProfile). Conhecimento sólido de Angular para desenvolvimento front-end. Experiência básica a intermediária com o protocolo FIX. Experiência com JUnit, RestAssured ou outros frameworks de automação de testes. Compreensão de APIs REST e desenvolvimento de aplicações web. Conhecimento de SQL e bancos de dados relacionais. Familiaridade com Git e pipelines de CI/CD.

title: Dotnet Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for .Net developer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Experienced 5+ years on .Net programing/sustaining

Able to troubleshoot the issues and fix from L2 and L3 support perspective

Able to do changes/enhancements on the application developed in .Net

Capable to create/manage documentation of the application developed in .Net

Strong knowledge with app integration by API or View

Available to be on-call at weekends and night-shift

Knowledge on Tasy application (from Philips ®) will be a differentiating factor


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Salesforce Tech Lead
description:
• Vaga REMOTA
  • Contrato PJ ou Cooperado


As atividades desse cargo envolvem:

  • Liderar todo o ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (SDLC) de projetos Salesforce: requisitos, design, desenvolvimento, testes, deploy e suporte.
  • Atuar como líder técnico, garantindo qualidade, prazos e orientando desenvolvedores juniores.
  • Colaborar diretamente com stakeholders de negócio para entendimento de requisitos, priorização de demandas e validação durante o UAT.
  • Planejamento e acompanhamento de sprints, estimativas, atribuição de tarefas e daily stand-ups.
  • Gestão de equipe offshore, assegurando alinhamento e entrega contínua.
  • Suporte e melhoria de aplicações Salesforce já existentes (bugs, performance, otimizações).


Requisitos:

  • Apex, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Visualforce, APIs SOAP/REST e ferramentas declarativas.
  • Forte foco em Salesforce Vlocity, com experiência em: EPC/CPQ, CLM, OmniScripts, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures (IPs).
  • Vivência com code review e deploys via GitHub e Jenkins.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Senior Financial Analyst


Role Summary

The FP&A Finance team is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support FP&A and month-end close activities across the Products FP&A team . This role requires a high degree of accuracy, attention to detail, and accountability to deadlines. Reporting to the Manager of Products FP&A , the analyst will be a key contributor across the broader FP&A organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and headcount analysis
  • Perform headcount reconciliation and reporting
  • Manage department expenses, including PO approval and tracking
  • Build and maintain financial models (Excel: intermediate to advanced)
  • Populate dashboards and KPI tools for data-driven decision-making
  • Monitor KPIs and analyze performance trends and drivers
  • Participate in monthly and quarterly close; prepare entries and reconciliations
  • Support global forecasting and budgeting for headcount and operational expenses
  • Conduct monthly variance analysis to ensure expenses are planned and justified
  • Prepare financial reporting for business partners (monthly, quarterly, ad hoc)
  • Perform margin analysis and automate manual reports in Excel and Hyperion
  • Provide general support for ad hoc projects and reporting requests
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management and Engineering teams
  • Operate independently in a remote-first environment with proactive communication

Qualifications

Education : Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance (MBA preferred but not required)

  • Experience : 4–7+ years in FP&A, financial analysis, P&L modeling, and monthly close
  • Strong preference for experience supporting R&D, Engineering, or Product teams
  • Experience in multi-national, dynamic business environments
  • Technical Skills :
  • Advanced Excel modeling and automation
  • ERP systems (Oracle required), Hyperion reporting
  • Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint; Excel: intermediate to advanced)
  • Soft Skills :
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Detail-oriented with excellent time management and prioritization
  • Clear communicator with ability to present data simply and effectively
  • Team-oriented, self-starter, and comfortable working cross-functionally
  • Able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Maintains confidentiality with sensitive financial data

title: Profissional Backend Java - Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga


Código da vaga: 56197


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência com Java para Backend e experiência com o framework Spring.
  • Vivência com serviços AWS.
  • Experiência prática em Clean Code e Arquitetura Hexagonal.
  • Habilidade para escrever e aplicar diversos tipos de Testes (Unitários, Integração, etc.).
  • Experiência com GitHub.
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD
  • Experiência com Terraform
  • Uso de ferramentas de monitoramento/observabilidade, como Datadog.


Modelo de atuação


  • 100% remoto



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

description:

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
Buscamos Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior Backend com forte especialização em C# .NET 8, com experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações web modernas, escaláveis e performáticas.

Este(a) profissional atuará no desenvolvimento completo de uma solução de larga escala com cerca de 11 mil usuários, utilizando serviços distribuídos, mensageria, Azure SQL e Azure Cloud.


Modelo de atuação: Remoto

️Nível de Inglês: Básico (leitura / escrita)


✅ Requisitos Obrigatórios

- Experiência sólida com C# .NET 8+ (preferencialmente .NET 8);

- Prática com Entity Framework e construção de consultas SQL complexas;

- Conhecimento em arquitetura de serviços distribuídos e mensageria (ex: Azure Service Bus);

- Experiência com Azure SQL Database e uso de recursos da Azure Cloud;

- Experiência com testes unitários e de integração (ex: xUnit, MSTest);

- Ferramentas de controle de versão (Git/GitFlow);

- Noções Integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD);

- Boa comunicação, proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar em times multidisciplinares;

- Nível de Inglês: Básico (leitura / escrita)


⚙️ Desejável / Diferenciais

- Conhecimento em autenticação (OAuth2, JWT, SSO);

- Práticas de segurança em aplicações web;

- Experiência com monitoramento e performance de aplicações em nuvem;

- Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);


Conheça mais sobre a Mouts: mouts.info

title: Fullstack Senior/Tech Lead - 100% Remote. Important AI Company
description:
Want a chance to (100% remote) work at a financially stable (and socially important) California-based AI company, and learn from seasoned tech leads that create software platforms that 10x patient healthcare? You'll get excellent pay with great benefits.


Purpose:

You'll be working on a revolutionary platform from a well respected company that's building AI to unlock healthcare super-abundance from humans, not chat-bots. Your code will 10x more ability for in-person doctor visits, making the highest quality healthcare available to everybody.


Absolute Hard Requirements:

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, NextJS
  • Backend: Node, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, AWS, NestJS, Kafka
  • Minimum 6+ years of experience


Interview Process:

  • No leet code, just real world exercises with tech leads who will treat you with the respect you deserve. We pay well, with great benefits most remote developers do Not get - because we only hire the best . Is this you?


Video question:

"What’s the most valuable engineering decision you made in the last 12 months? Why was it valuable?"


Submit your video here: 


*Applications that submitted a 60-second video answering the question will be given the highest priority . Only our most Senior HR Manager will watch your video and delete it afterward. We review 100% of the videos submitted.


Please do not apply if you do not meet our requirements, as we won’t be able to respond.

description:
Tasks:

  • Ensure regulatory and GxP/GEP compliance; strong understanding of RA/MOH requirements and protocol implementation across regions.
  • Plan, execute, and close clinical projects within scope, time, and budget; build timelines and manage risks, resources, and milestones.

  • End-to-end project delivery; risk, resource & milestone management

  • Budget forecasting, burn-rate & scope control
  • Clear stakeholder communication & actionable guidance
  • Risk anticipation, adaptability & solution-oriented approach

Location : remote

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Sobre o Papel

O papel envolve o desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e escaláveis utilizando Java e tecnologias modernas, com foco em microserviços e integração de APIs.



Responsabilidades


  • Conhecimento Profundo em Java - Experiência com recursos modernos como Virtual Threads, Pattern Matching e demais melhorias da versão.
  • Frameworks
  • Spring Boot: Desenvolvimento de microserviços e aplicações RESTful.
  • Spring Data: Integração com bancos de dados e abstração de acesso a dados.
  • Arquitetura e Design de Software
  • Experiência com Microservices, Clean Architecture e Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Aplicação de princípios SOLID e design patterns.
  • APIs e Integração
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e GraphQL.
  • Integração e documentação de APIs com OpenAPI/Swagger.
  • Persistência de Dados
  • Experiência com JPA e Hibernate (ORM).
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
  • Interface do Usuário (UI)
  • HTML5 & CSS3 → Estruturação e estilização de páginas.
  • JavaScript (ES6+) → Manipulação do DOM, Promises, Async/Await.
  • TypeScript → Tipagem estática para maior segurança no código.
  • Responsive Design → Uso de Flexbox, Grid e Media Queries.
  • Pré-processadores CSS → SASS/SCSS, PostCSS.
  • Frameworks de UI → Material UI, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Ant Design.
  • Cloud e Infraestrutura
  • Cloud Services - Conhecimento em AWS.
  • Metodologias e Ferramentas
  • Metodologias Ágeis
  • Experiência com equipes Agile em frameworks como Scrum.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Jira.


Qualificações

Educação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada.


Habilidades Necessárias

  • Proficiência em Java e frameworks relacionados.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs e integração de sistemas.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis.


Habilidades Preferenciais

  • Experiência com AWS e serviços de nuvem.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de UI e design responsivo.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 56240


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional Engenheiro de Dados, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

• Experiência sólida com Google Cloud Platform .

• Domínio em: o BigQuery o Cloud Storage (GCS) o Cloud Run o Vertex AI o Airflow/Cloud Composer

• Vivência prática na criação, versionamento e monitoramento de DAGs.

• Proficiência em Python e conhecimento intermediário/avançado em SQL .

• Conhecimento de arquiteturas Lakehouse.

• Experiência com CI/CD (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions) .

• Experiência com Git e boas práticas de engenharia de dados.


Responsabilidades

• Desenvolver, evoluir e manter DAGs no Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer.

• Construir pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) escaláveis e de alta performance.

• Criar modelos, tabelas e rotinas de dados no BigQuery.

• Implementar integrações e serviços utilizando Cloud Run ou Cloud Functions.

• Estruturar e gerenciar camadas de dados no Google Cloud Storage.

• Colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e analytics na definição de soluções de dados.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Manager Operations BPS Brazil
description:
Role Purpose

Drive continuous improvement initiatives across BPS operations to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve service quality. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify process gaps and implement best practices.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide timely and meaningful reporting to senior management.
  • Plan and implement strategies to ensure account profitability.
  • Handle client interactions and manage escalations (calls or in-person).
  • Conduct regular reviews with Account Managers and other departments to ensure SLA adherence.
  • Monitor daily productivity against defined service level standards.
  • Perform audit checks on client-defined compliance requirements.
  • Coach and monitor Team Leads and AMs in day-to-day operations and people management.
  • Develop continuous learning processes for the team.
  • Supervise and support team members to ensure delivery meets or exceeds client quality standards.
  • Represent the organization during client visits and reviews.
  • Lead process re-engineering projects to optimize workflows and reduce cycle times.
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, SOPs, and compliance standards.
  • Partner with stakeholders to implement digital tools and automation for operational efficiency.
  • Monitor KPIs and prepare dashboards to track improvement outcomes.
  • Conduct training sessions on process excellence methodologies for team members.


Required/ Preferred Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of BPS operations and service delivery models.
  • Provide timely and meaningful reporting to senior management.
  • Plan and implement strategies to ensure account profitability.
  • Handle client interactions and manage escalations (calls or in-person).
  • Conduct regular reviews with Account Managers and other departments to ensure SLA adherence.
  • Monitor daily productivity against defined service level standards.
  • Perform audit checks on client-defined compliance requirements.
  • Coach and monitor Team Leads and AMs in day-to-day operations and people management.
  • Develop continuous learning processes for the team.
  • Supervise and support team members to ensure delivery meets or exceeds client quality standards.
  • Represent the organization during client visits and reviews.
  • Proficiency in process mapping tools and data analysis (Excel, Power BI).
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver within timelines.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in process improvement within BPS or shared services.
  • Preferred Certification in Lean Six Sigma or equivalent preferred.

title: Human Resources Assistant
description:
Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions (Effective 8/01/25)


  • Do you live in Brazil and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing?
  • Do you love to read, write, and analyze things?
  • Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker?
  • Can you type both fast and accurately?
  • Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge and your income?
  • Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a stable, long-term career related to HR?
  • Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail?
  • Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting?
  • Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations?
  • Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities?


If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team! Please review the minimum education/experience requirements below to see if you qualify for the position.


About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies.


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.


Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:


Compensation:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $4,200 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. Work as a CLS HR & Investigation Assistant for a minimum of 1 year with competent performance and become eligible for promotion to the Specialist position.


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting total monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $9,000 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. 


Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:


·      High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.


Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office

Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.


Minimum/Required and Preferred Qualifications


Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT:

·      Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

·      A minimum of 1 year of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 1-year requirement).

·      A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

·      A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.

·      Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.

·      3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred. 

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is preferred.


Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST:

·      Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

·      At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English is required . Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English.

·      A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is required.

·      Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.

·      A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required. A Master's Degree is preferred.

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is preferred .


GROW at CLS! PROMOTIONAL POSITIONS ONLY for CURRENT CLS TEAM MEMBERS:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SUPERVISOR (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $9,800 BRL to $16,800 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6-months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION MANAGER (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $16,800 BRL to $27,000 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6 months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.


How to Apply? 2 Steps for a Complete Application


Please read the entire job description carefully and apply if you meet all the minimum requirements.


STEP #1: Send an email with the following to :

·      Your current/updated resume in English.

·      A written statement about how you satisfy each of the required and preferred qualifications for the position.

·      Your job salary history for all jobs listed on your resume (including starting and ending salary for each job stated in COP) and any bonus opportunities that you had in each job.


STEP #2:

We would like to evaluate your English verbal skills. Please send a video message via WhatsApp at and introduce yourself. (Please do not read. Speak naturally.)


You must provide all the requested information and complete all the steps listed above for your application to be complete.


Please send your complete application as soon as possible. We are coordinating interviews now!

For more information about the company, please visit:

above.

description:
Hiring: Cloud Engineer (GCP / AWS / Python / AVID MAM)

Location: Remote / Hybrid (based on region)

Experience Level: Mid–Senior


About the Role


We are looking for a skilled Cloud Engineer with strong experience across Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, Python development, and workflow migration. The ideal candidate will also have hands-on expertise with AVID Media Asset Management (MAM) systems and the ability to support modern CI/CD deployment practices.
