title: Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
Estamos contratando SDR - Home office


Você é um SDR focado em gerar mais resultados…. essa vaga é pra você!

Não quero saber do seu currículo, nem quero saber do seu diploma, eu quero a sua responsabilidade e lealdade para executar o processo. 


Tipo de Contrato: PJ

Modelo de trabalho: Home office


Buscamos por pessoas obstinadas em superar as metas e com um bom histórico.

O candidato ideal compartilhará nossos valores de honestidade, transparência e compromisso com a satisfação do cliente.

Excelente estrutura salarial e de comissões sobre as metas.

Se você não tem disposição e coração ensinável para aprender, nem preencha. 


Cargo: SDR


Principais responsabilidades da função:

Fazer a triagem e qualificação de leads inbound, identificando oportunidades de negócio;

Agendar reuniões estratégicas qualificadas; 

Qualificar os leads via Instagram e whatsaap; 

Fazer lista de prospecção;

Fazer captação outbound pela rede social; 

Executar follow-ups estratégicos, mantendo relacionamento e acompanhando o ciclo de decisão dos leads;

Gerenciar e atualizar o funil de oportunidades no CRM, garantindo organização e previsibilidade nas vendas;

Trabalhar em parceria com o time de marketing e vendas, alinhando estratégias e feedbacks;


Requisitos:

✅ Organização e comprometimento 

✅ Capacidade de vestir a camisa da empresa 

✅ Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente;

✅Tenha “fome” de resultado


O que oferecemos:

• Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo com oportunidades de crescimento.

• Treinamento e desenvolvimento contínuo para aprimoramento profissional na área.

• Remuneração fixa competitiva + comissão.


Requisitos Comportamentais:

- Excelente comunicação interpessoal;

- Proatividade;

- Empatia;

- Escuta ativa;

- Atenção aos detalhes;

- Foco em qualidade.


Candidate-se e venha fazer parte de um time que transforma o mercado brasileiro!

title: Analista de Dados
description:
A GP Strategies Corporation é um dos principais fornecedores mundiais de transformação de talentos. Ao oferecer soluções premiadas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento, ajudamos as organizações a se transformarem por meio de seu pessoal e a alcançarem mudanças significativas. A GP Strategies forneceu suas soluções inovadoras de consultoria, serviços de aprendizado e tecnologia de talentos para mais de 6.000 organizações em todo o mundo.


Com base em nossa experiência global de trabalho em milhares de projetos e iniciativas nos últimos 55 anos, aprendemos que relacionamentos, negócios, trabalho, inovação, estratégia e transformação têm tudo a ver com pessoas. E, em poucas palavras, a GP Strategies é o nosso pessoal: uma extensa rede global de especialistas em aprendizado. Saiba mais em


Estamos procurando um Analista de Dados que será responsável por analisar, interpretar e transformar dados relacionados aos programas de treinamento corporativo em insights estratégicos, garantindo a tomada de decisão baseada em dados para otimização de processos, melhoria da experiência do participante e aumento da eficácia dos treinamentos, incluindo a mensuração do retorno sobre investimento .


Esquema de trabalho: Remoto.


Principais atividades:


  • Coletar, organizar e validar dados provenientes de plataformas de treinamento, LMS (Learning Management System), pesquisas de satisfação e indicadores de desempenho.
  • Desenvolver dashboards e relatórios avançados para monitoramento de KPIs (ex.: taxa de conclusão, engajamento, impacto no negócio).
  • Realizar análises preditivas e prescritivas para identificar tendências, padrões e oportunidades de melhoria nos programas de capacitação.
  • Calcular e analisar o ROI dos programas de treinamento, considerando custos, benefícios tangíveis e intangíveis, e impacto nos resultados do negócio.
  • Apoiar a definição de métricas e indicadores estratégicos para mensuração da eficácia e retorno dos treinamentos.
  • Garantir a qualidade e integridade dos dados, propondo melhorias nos processos de coleta e integração.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) e linguagens de programação (SQL, Python, R) para análises avançadas.
  • Automatizar bases de dados com Power BI e Excel, de forma a otimizar o tempo de resposta
  • Elaborar apresentações executivas com insights claros e recomendações para stakeholders.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Formação superior em Estatística, Ciência de Dados, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em análise de dados, preferencialmente aplicada à área de Treinamentos ou RH.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados.
  • Desejável conhecimento avançado em SQL e linguagens de análise (Python ou R).
  • Experiência com modelagem estatística, análise preditiva e cálculo de ROI.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado (desejável).


Desejável

  • Facilidade com números e capacidade de defender decisões com embasamento quantitativo.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de aplicativos simples para suporte a treinamentos (ex.: quizzes e dentre outros)
  • Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial aplicadas à análise de dados e otimização de processos.


Com mais de 4.000 funcionários em mais de 30 países, a diversidade na GP Strategies é uma segunda natureza! Além de nossas localidades, nossa cultura se concentra no desempenho e gira em torno do respeito, da justiça e do trabalho colaborativo para atingir nossos objetivos. Apoiamos nossos funcionários, não importa quem sejam ou de onde venham, porque todos nós temos perspectivas e abordagens valiosas e exclusivas. É assim que nascem as grandes ideias, que nos permitem trabalhar de forma mais inteligente.


A GP Strategies tem o compromisso e o orgulho de ser um empregador de oportunidades iguais. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para emprego sem levar em conta raça, nacionalidade, gênero, idade, religião, deficiência, orientação sexual, status de veterano ou estado civil.

title: Software Consultant - Personalization
description:
OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner, we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.


Position: Personalization Specialist

We are seeking a skilled Personalization Specialist to join our team in Porto. The ideal candidate will be responsible for implementing and maintaining the Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization platform, ensuring effective and continuous campaign management.

Responsibilities:

• Implement and maintain the Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization platform.

• Develop and manage Personalization sitemaps using JavaScript, following the platform’s library and standards.

• Create and customize campaign templates, adapting global models or developing solutions from scratch.

• Collaborate with marketing and development teams to integrate the platform with other systems, ensuring campaign effectiveness and continuity.

• Monitor campaign performance and propose improvements to optimize results.

Requirements:

• Proven experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization (Interaction Studio/Evergage).

• Skilled in developing Personalization sitemaps using JavaScript.

• Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript.

• Experience creating and customizing campaign templates.

• Strong teamwork skills with a results-oriented mindset.

Nice to Have:

• Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement.

• Certifications in Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization.

• Developer certification in Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement.

Languages:

• English is not mandatory but considered a plus.


OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

title: Líder técnico
description:
Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead para atuar junto ao time, liderando uma equipe multidisciplinar de 6 profissionais (Devs, QA e DevOps). Esse será o profissional-chave para definição de arquitetura, priorização técnica e escolha de tecnologias que sustentam projetos de grande escala em PHP/WordPress, garantindo robustez, escalabilidade e inovação.


Nosso ecossistema atende mais de 150 mil usuários ativos e integra soluções como BuddyBoss, LearnDash e automações educacionais, exigindo alta performance e qualidade em ambientes complexos.


Responsabilidades


- Definir a arquitetura de novos módulos, produtos e integrações.

- Priorizar demandas técnicas e orientar o time nas entregas.

- Liderar revisões de código e garantir boas práticas de engenharia de software.

- Apoiar e desenvolver a equipe, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.

- Tomar decisões estratégicas sobre tecnologias e padrões de desenvolvimento.

- Atuar em conjunto com gestores de produto e stakeholders na definição de roadmap.

- Garantir segurança, escalabilidade e performance da plataforma.

- Conduzir integrações complexas com APIs e serviços externos.

- Coordenar processos de CI/CD, automação de deploy e monitoramento.


Requisitos Técnicos


- Experiência sólida com PHP e desenvolvimento avançado em WordPress (plugins, multisite, customizações complexas).

- Vivência em projetos de alta escala (grandes volumes de usuários e dados).

- Domínio em arquitetura de software e boas práticas de design.

- Conhecimento em BuddyBoss, LearnDash e integrações com ecossistemas educacionais.

- Forte experiência em MySQL/MariaDB (queries otimizadas, escalabilidade de banco).

- Experiência em segurança de aplicações web (XSS, CSRF, SQL Injection, etc.).

- Fluência em Git, CI/CD e automação de deploy.

- Vivência com AWS.

- Histórico comprovado de liderança técnica ou gestão de equipes de desenvolvimento.

- Experiência prévia em projetos de educação (EdTech, LMS, SaaS educacionais).

- Conhecimento em DevOps (containers, monitoramento, observabilidade).

- Capacidade de comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e não técn

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno Fullstack (ReactJS, Node.js, MySQL)
description:
REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS

Modelo de trabalho

· 100% Home Office

· Salário compatível com o mercado de trabalho


Benefícios

· Vale-Refeição: R$ 30,00 por dia útil

· Convênio Médico e Odontológico: 50% pago pela empresa

· TotalPass: colaborador + 3 dependentes

· Convênio Farmácia Drogal

· Laboratório de Cultura: acesso a cursos, livros, filmes e conteúdos de desenvolvimento

· Day Off no aniversário de empresa


Obrigatórios

• Domínio de ReactJS (hooks, componentização, estado global, SPA).

• Domínio de Node.js (Express/Fastify, APIs REST, middlewares).

• Experiência sólida com MySQL (consultas complexas, joins, índices).

• Conhecimento prático de Clean Code e princípios SOLID.

• Vivência real com DDD aplicado (entidades, agregados, repositórios, bounded contexts).

• Experiência com arquiteturas modernas (camadas bem definidas, modularização).

• Testes unitários e de integração (Jest, Vitest, Supertest ou similares).

• Integração entre frontend e backend, incluindo autenticação JWT.

• Capacidade de refatorar código legado aplicando boas práticas.

• Uso de Git Flow (main, release, hotfix) no dia a dia.

• Mínimo de 3 anos já atuando como Desenvolvedor Fullstack

Desejáveis

• Experiência com Arquitetura Hexagonal ou CQRS.

• Experiência com WebSockets (comunicação em tempo real).

• Cache com Redis e filas (RabbitMQ/Kafka).

• Documentação com Swagger ou similar.

• Monitoramento e logs (Grafana, ELK, PM2, Datadog).

• Conhecimento fiscal (NFe, CFOP, CST, ICMS) — diferencial importante.

• Experiência com sistemas ERP ou sistemas automotivos.

title: Analista de Inteligência Artificial
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países, liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital para grandes clientes. Somos uma das mais prestigiadas empresas de negócios e tecnologia da América Latina, com metodologia especializada e equipe técnica em automação e Hiperautomação.

Temos parcerias e certificações com plataformas líderes de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner com UiPath, Platinum Partner com Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner com Microsoft e Silver Partner com IBM. Nossa experiência e expertise em serviços de automação nos renderam, entre vários prêmios, o selo USN (UiPath Service Network) e o prêmio LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de IA apaixonado(a) por inovação para integrar nosso time de dados. O foco principal será arquitetar, desenvolver e implantar soluções de Machine Learning e Inteligência Artificial Generativa utilizando o ecossistema do Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .

Você será a ponte entre a ciência de dados e a engenharia de produção, garantindo que nossos modelos não apenas funcionem em laboratório, mas gerem valor real e escalável para o negócio, aproveitando o poder do Vertex AI e dos modelos Gemini.


1. Responsabilidades e Atribuições

O que você fará no dia a dia:

  • Desenvolvimento e Deploy: Projetar e implementar pipelines de ML (treinamento e inferência) utilizando Google Vertex AI.
  • IA Generativa: Criar soluções utilizando as APIs do Gemini (Pro/Flash) e PaLM, aplicando técnicas de Prompt Engineering e Fine-tuning quando necessário.
  • Engenharia de Dados para IA: Atuar com BigQuery para preparação de datasets massivos e feature engineering.
  • Integração: Conectar modelos de IA com outras aplicações da empresa via Cloud Functions ou Cloud Run.
  • Inovação: Pesquisar novas ferramentas do Google Cloud (ex: Agent Builder, Document AI) para propor melhorias nos processos atuais.


2. Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

Indispensáveis:

  • Linguagem de Programação: Domínio avançado de Python e suas bibliotecas principais (Pandas, Scikit-learn).
  • Cloud Computing: Experiência comprovada em GCP, especificamente: Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage e Compute Engine.
  • SQL: Escrita de queries complexas e otimizadas no BigQuery.


3. Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

Para ter sucesso nesta função, buscamos alguém com:

  • Mentalidade "Problem-Solver": Capacidade de traduzir um problema de negócio vago em uma solução técnica estruturada de IA.
  • Adaptabilidade: O ecossistema de IA muda semanalmente. Você precisa gostar de estudar e se adaptar a novas ferramentas (como novos modelos do Gemini) rapidamente.
  • Comunicação Clara: Habilidade de explicar conceitos complexos (como alucinação de IA ou bias) para stakeholders não técnicos.
  • Colaboração Cross-Functional: Trabalhar bem com Engenheiros de Dados, Desenvolvedores Backend e Product Owners.


4.Diferenciais (Nice to have):

  • Certificação Google
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation): Experiência prática na construção de sistemas de busca vetorial (Vector Search) no GCP.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:


Job Description:

You are a gritty problem solver and self-starter who will be a crucial interface between the Analytics team and Engineering team. On one hand, you thoroughly understand the needs of the

Analytics team and are able to predict future requirements. On the other hand, you partner with the Data Engineers to identify,vet, and prioritize upstream data to fulfill and facilitate the

analytics needs. Your goal is to provide capability and drive operational excellence for the analytics team, while bringing efficiency to the partnership.

title: Service Desk Engineer (LATAM)
description:
About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.


Summary


We are looking for a motivated and skilled Service Desk Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will deliver exceptional technical support to clients, ensuring smooth and efficient operation of their IT environments. Fluency in English is required, and knowledge of an additional language is a plus. This role suits a proactive professional with experience in Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and strong proficiency in tools such as Salesforce, Slack, and Office 365. An ITIL certification is advantageous and reflects a commitment to industry best practices.


Key Responsibilities


Technical Support


  • Provide first- and second-line support via email and remote tools.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues involving Office 365, Salesforce, Slack, and other business applications.
  • Log, track, and manage incidents and service requests across various platforms.


Client Interaction


  • Deliver a professional, customer-focused experience during all interactions.
  • Translate technical issues into clear, user-friendly language.
  • Escalate unresolved issues appropriately and ensure timely follow-up.


Service Management


  • Adhere to ITIL-aligned processes for incident, problem, and change management.
  • Monitor and meet SLA requirements for all client requests.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance service delivery and client satisfaction.


Collaboration & Documentation


  • Work closely with internal teams and vendors to resolve complex issues.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of incidents, changes, and resolutions.
  • Create and update knowledge base articles for recurring issues.


Tools & Technology


  • Use and support applications such as Office 365, Salesforce, and Slack.
  • Administer user accounts, permissions, and configurations.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices.


Qualifications & Skills


  • Fluency in English and Spanish (written and verbal).
  • 2+ years of experience in an MSP environment.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce or similar ticketing platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.


Core Competencies

  • Technical troubleshooting
  • Customer service orientation
  • Communication & documentation
  • Time management

title: Service Desk Engineer (LATAM)
description:
About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.


Summary


We are looking for a motivated and skilled Service Desk Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will deliver exceptional technical support to clients, ensuring smooth and efficient operation of their IT environments. Fluency in English is required, and knowledge of an additional language is a plus. This role suits a proactive professional with experience in Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and strong proficiency in tools such as Salesforce, Slack, and Office 365. An ITIL certification is advantageous and reflects a commitment to industry best practices.


Key Responsibilities


Technical Support


  • Provide first- and second-line support via email and remote tools.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues involving Office 365, Salesforce, Slack, and other business applications.
  • Log, track, and manage incidents and service requests across various platforms.


Client Interaction


  • Deliver a professional, customer-focused experience during all interactions.
  • Translate technical issues into clear, user-friendly language.
  • Escalate unresolved issues appropriately and ensure timely follow-up.


Service Management


  • Adhere to ITIL-aligned processes for incident, problem, and change management.
  • Monitor and meet SLA requirements for all client requests.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance service delivery and client satisfaction.


Collaboration & Documentation


  • Work closely with internal teams and vendors to resolve complex issues.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of incidents, changes, and resolutions.
  • Create and update knowledge base articles for recurring issues.


Tools & Technology


  • Use and support applications such as Office 365, Salesforce, and Slack.
  • Administer user accounts, permissions, and configurations.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices.


Qualifications & Skills


  • Fluency in English and Spanish (written and verbal).
  • 2+ years of experience in an MSP environment.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce or similar ticketing platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.


Core Competencies

  • Technical troubleshooting
  • Customer service orientation
  • Communication & documentation
  • Time management
  • Problem-solving
  • Process discipline
  • Collaboration
  • Attention to detail

description:
Vaga: Consultor(a) de Programas de Intercâmbio – Graduação, Mestrado e Cursos Profissionais


A TKS Intercâmbio busca um(a) profissional apaixonado(a) por educação internacional para atuar no atendimento e orientação de estudantes interessados em graduação, mestrado e programas profissionais na Espanha e em outros destinos globais.


Se você tem experiência na área, acredita no poder transformador do intercâmbio e gosta de trabalhar com propósito, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades

Atender e orientar clientes de forma consultiva, entendendo seus objetivos acadêmicos e profissionais.

Auxiliar na escolha de cursos, instituições e destinos.

Utilizar ferramentas de pesquisa e acompanhamento para propor as melhores soluções educacionais.


Requisitos

✔️ Experiência comprovada de pelo menos 2 anos na área.

✔️ Vivência com plataformas de busca de cursos, como GeeBee ou Uniapply.

✔️ Ter realizado um intercâmbio.

✔️ Disponibilidade para atuar em modelo remoto.


O que oferecemos

Remuneração fixa + comissão atrativa.

Cultura baseada em respeito, transparência, autoestima e comprometimento.

title: Junior Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Java Developer to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics, and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure the code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Desenvolvedor de front-end
description:
⚠ *ASSURANCE IT* contrata Desenvolvedores FrontEnd (Angular e JavaScript)

Cargo: Desenvolvedor Front-End (Angular e JavaScript)

Local: 100% Remoto

Período de alocação: 6 meses (possibilidade de absorção)

Horário de Trabalho: 9h às 18h

Modelo de Contrato: PJ


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, testar e manter funcionalidades de front-end utilizando Angular e JavaScript.

- Colaborar com designers UX/UI para implementar interfaces amigáveis ao usuário.

- Otimizar aplicações para máxima velocidade e escalabilidade.

- Garantir a viabilidade técnica dos designs de UI/UX.

- Integrar componentes de front-end com serviços e APIs de back-end.

- Identificar, solucionar e corrigir problemas em diversos navegadores e dispositivos.

- Participar de revisões de código, garantindo qualidade e boas práticas.

- Manter-se atualizado sobre novas tecnologias e frameworks de front-end.


Requisitos:

- Experiência comprovada como Desenvolvedor Front-End

- Forte foco em Angular e JavaScript

- Sólido entendimento de HTML5, CSS3 e princípios de design responsivo.

- Experiência com APIs RESTful e integração com serviços de back-end.

- Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão (Git).

- Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.

- Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração.

- Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas relacionadas.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior – AI-Driven - Remoto
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior – AI-Driven

Remoto


Link da Vaga:



Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior com sólida experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações empresariais reais e forte interesse em Inteligência Artificial & Prompt-First Engineering para integrar nosso Corporate Value Creation Team. Essa pessoa atuará em diversas empresas do portfólio, utilizando ferramentas de IA como Cursor e GitHub Copilot para gerar rapidamente aplicações full stack em .NET que sejam altamente manuteníveis, escaláveis e de alto desempenho.

O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui no mínimo 6 meses de experiência prática com ferramentas de codificação assistida por IA e é proficiente na escrita de consultas T-SQL e no design de bancos de dados para SQL Server. Também deve ter familiaridade com revisões de código, metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban) e com ambientes de desenvolvimento potencializados por IA.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações full stack em .NET, seguindo Clean Architecture e princípios SOLID para garantir manutenibilidade a longo prazo.
  • Aplicar princípios de Prompt-First Engineering para maximizar a eficácia de ferramentas de codificação com IA (por exemplo, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) no desenvolvimento full stack.
  • Escrever e otimizar consultas T-SQL, procedimentos armazenados e esquemas de banco de dados no SQL Server para suportar operações de dados escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Criar aplicações corporativas robustas para resolver desafios complexos operacionais, financeiros e de fluxo de trabalho em diversos setores.
  • Participar ativamente de revisões de código, garantindo qualidade, manutenibilidade e boa documentação.
  • Trabalhar dentro de frameworks ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), participando de planejamentos, reuniões diárias e retrospectivas.
  • Colaborar com gerentes de produto, designers e engenheiros para entregar soluções seguras, eficientes e robustas.
  • Projetar e implementar aplicações nativas em nuvem, APIs e microsserviços em .NET e .NET Core.
  • Contribuir para testes automatizados, pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de DevOps para garantir qualidade e agilidade nas entregas.

    • Requisitos


    • Foco em Inteligência Artificial & Prompt-First Engineering , aplicando essas práticas no desenvolvimento de software.
    • 3+ anos de experiência desenvolvendo aplicações C#/.NET em ambientes empresariais reais.
    • 6+ meses de experiência prática com ferramentas de codificação assistida por IA (por exemplo, Cursor, GitHub Copilot).
    • Sólido conhecimento e aplicação de Clean Architecture e princípios SOLID.
    • Proficiência na escrita e otimização de consultas T-SQL e experiência com SQL Server.
    • Experiência em aplicações corporativas de grande porte, como ERP, CRM, sistemas financeiros ou plataformas de automação de processos.
    • Forte experiência em revisões de código, escrita de código manutenível e aplicação de boas práticas.
    • Experiência com metodologias ágeis, incluindo Scrum ou Kanban.
    • Familiaridade com REST APIs, plataformas em nuvem (preferencialmente Azure) e arquitetura de microsserviços.
    • Perfil proativo e adaptável, com boa performance em ambientes acelerados e potencializados por IA.
    • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e paixão por utilizar IA para otimizar engenharia de software.
    • Fluência em inglês (oral e escrita) para comunicação em ambiente global.


    Diferenciais


    • Experiência com frameworks de front-end (Blazor, React ou Angular).
    • Familiaridade com DevOps, pipelines de CI/CD e testes automatizados.


    Por que trabalhar conosco?

    • Atuar diretamente com empresas do portfólio para impulsionar inovação e gerar impacto real.
    • Utilizar ferramentas de IA de última geração para acelerar o desenvolvimento full stack.
    • Fazer parte de um time de alto desempenho dentro de uma empresa de investimentos de longo prazo.
    • Pacote competitivo de remuneração, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento profissional.

  • Contribuir para testes automatizados, pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de DevOps para garantir qualidade e agilidade nas entregas.

    • Requisitos


    • Foco em Inteligência Artificial & Prompt-First Engineering , aplicando essas práticas no desenvolvimento de software.
    • 3+ anos de experiência desenvolvendo aplicações C#/.NET em ambientes empresariais reais.
    • 6+ meses de experiência prática com ferramentas de codificação assistida por IA (por exemplo, Cursor, GitHub Copilot).
    • Sólido conhecimento e aplicação de Clean Architecture e princípios SOLID.
    • Proficiência na escrita e otimização de consultas T-SQL e experiência com SQL Server.
    • Experiência em aplicações corporativas de grande porte, como ERP, CRM, sistemas financeiros ou plataformas de automação de processos.
    • Forte experiência em revisões de código, escrita de código manutenível e aplicação de boas práticas.
    • Experiência com metodologias ágeis, incluindo Scrum ou Kanban.
    • Familiaridade com REST APIs, plataformas em nuvem (preferencialmente Azure) e arquitetura de microsserviços.
    • Perfil proativo e adaptável, com boa performance em ambientes acelerados e potencializados por IA.
    • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e paixão por utilizar IA para otimizar engenharia de software.
    • Fluência em inglês (oral e escrita) para comunicação em ambiente global.


    Diferenciais


    • Experiência com frameworks de front-end (Blazor, React ou Angular).
    • Familiaridade com DevOps, pipelines de CI/CD e testes automatizados.


    Por que trabalhar conosco?

    • Atuar diretamente com empresas do portfólio para impulsionar inovação e gerar impacto real.
    • Utilizar ferramentas de IA de última geração para acelerar o desenvolvimento full stack.
    • Fazer parte de um time de alto desempenho dentro de uma empresa de investimentos de longo prazo.
    • Pacote competitivo de remuneração, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento profissional.

title: Suporte Python Tech Ops
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Solucionar problemas de suporte e solicitações técnicas relacionadas a sistemas de produção.
  • Conduzir análises técnicas aprofundadas de incidentes, realizando investigações.
  • Monitorar, relatar e solucionar problemas de pipeline de dados e sistemas de back-end
  • Analisar fluxos de trabalho e criar relatórios de defeitos / falhas detalhados

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Proficiência em depuração de problemas técnicos;
  • Proficiente em SQL e familiarizado com ecossistemas de Big Data como Cassandra, Flink, Kafka e outras tecnologias relacionadas.
  • Conhecimento de scripts com Python ou linguagens similares para automatizar tarefas e solucionar problemas de forma eficiente.
  • Experiência em depuração de API Requests e problemas de respostas usando ferramentas como Charles, logs de rede ou métodos semelhantes;
  • Experiência com implementação e administração de ferramentas de monitoramento, registro e telemetria (por exemplo, Splunk, Prometheus, etc.).
  • Ingles avançado para escrita e conversação (obrigatório, projeto internacional).

title: Reddit Ads Media Buyer
description:
So… who is Residence Supply? 

We’re the fastest-growing design-driven lighting & hardware brand in the U.S. In two years we blew past 8 figures, launched hundreds of handcrafted SKUs, and built a cult following of design lovers who care more about heritage than hype. Our fixtures live in Architectural Digest–level homes and premium short-term rentals. Now we want our Reddit acquisition funnel to match the caliber of our product and brand.


We’re not hiring a “traffic manager.” We’re looking for a performance-obsessed Reddit Media Buyer who knows how to turn cold subreddits into profitable customers. Someone who lives inside the Reddit ads dashboard, understands communities, and can engineer profitable campaigns for a DTC home & garden brand at scale.


You should think in ROAS, CAC, and MER — not impressions. Your edge is your ability to test, learn fast, and turn signal into spend.


What you'll do

  •  Own Reddit as a performance channel for Residence Supply (from strategy → build → launch → scale).
  • Build and manage full-funnel ad structures: awareness, consideration, and conversion campaigns for home & garden buyers.
  • Research and map high-intent subreddits (home décor, interior design, DIY, home improvement, smart home, etc.) into scalable audience plans.
  • Write, brief, and iterate ad creatives that feel native to Reddit but drive clicks and conversions for our SKUs.
  • Set up, manage, and optimize campaigns daily for ROAS, CAC, CTR, and CVR targets.
  • Run structured A/B tests across:
  • Creative (angles, copy, formats, UGC vs. branded)
  • Audience (subreddit clusters, interests, lookalikes, remarketing)
  • Bids & budgets (CPC vs. CPM, dayparting, pacing)
  • Collaborate with our creative and CRO teams to tighten the full funnel: from ad → landing page → checkout → LTV.
  • Report results with clarity: what you tested, what worked, what didn’t, and your next moves.
  • Build playbooks so Reddit is a repeatable, scalable acquisition channel — not a one-off experiment.


What you bring

  • 2+ years running Reddit Ads for DTC brands (home, décor, furniture, home improvement, or similar verticals is a big plus).
  • Proven track record of hitting or beating performance targets: ROAS, CAC, MER, and revenue goals.
  • You can show real accounts (anonymized) where:
  • You profitably scaled spend
  • You turned a “test budget” into a core channel
  • Deep understanding of how Reddit communities behave and how to make ads feel non-cringe/non-corporate.
  • Strong skills in:
  • Campaign structure and account architecture
  • Creative testing frameworks
  • UTM tracking & basic analytics (GA4, post-purchase surveys, etc.)
  • Comfort working remote in a high-output environment: you set your own testing roadmap and bring solutions, not problems.
  • Bias for action: you’d rather ship a smart test today than debate a “perfect” plan for a week.


What we're offering

  • Fully remote role with a high-autonomy, performance-first culture.
  • Competitive base compensation (USD) + performance-based bonus tied to ROAS, CAC, and revenue growth.
  • Opportunity to expand your ownership into other paid channels (Meta, YouTube, display) if you prove you can drive results.
  • Direct access to leadership; your performance will have a visible impact on company growth.
  • A brand with real product-market fit and a rich catalogue to scale — not a struggling product you have to “save” with ads.


How you fit into the team

You’ll report directly to the Head of Growth and work closely with:

  • Creative: to brief concepts, hooks, and visual directions tailored to Reddit.
  • CRO / Web: to align landing pages, offers, and funnels with your traffic.
  • Analytics: to ensure tracking, attribution, and dashboards are clean and accurate.

Your success is simple to measure:

  • Can you profitably scale Reddit into a core channel for Residence Supply?
  • Can you build a testing engine that continuously improves performance?


If yes, you’ll have uncapped room to grow with us.

  • Deep understanding of how Reddit communities behave and how to make ads feel non-cringe/non-corporate.
  • Strong skills in:
  • Campaign structure and account architecture
  • Creative testing frameworks
  • UTM tracking & basic analytics (GA4, post-purchase surveys, etc.)
  • Comfort working remote in a high-output environment: you set your own testing roadmap and bring solutions, not problems.
  • Bias for action: you’d rather ship a smart test today than debate a “perfect” plan for a week.


What we're offering

  • Fully remote role with a high-autonomy, performance-first culture.
  • Competitive base compensation (USD) + performance-based bonus tied to ROAS, CAC, and revenue growth.
  • Opportunity to expand your ownership into other paid channels (Meta, YouTube, display) if you prove you can drive results.
  • Direct access to leadership; your performance will have a visible impact on company growth.
  • A brand with real product-market fit and a rich catalogue to scale — not a struggling product you have to “save” with ads.


How you fit into the team

You’ll report directly to the Head of Growth and work closely with:

  • Creative: to brief concepts, hooks, and visual directions tailored to Reddit.
  • CRO / Web: to align landing pages, offers, and funnels with your traffic.
  • Analytics: to ensure tracking, attribution, and dashboards are clean and accurate.

Your success is simple to measure:

  • Can you profitably scale Reddit into a core channel for Residence Supply?
  • Can you build a testing engine that continuously improves performance?


If yes, you’ll have uncapped room to grow with us.

description:

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.

  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)

  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

title: AWS Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Data Scientist - Especialista
description:
Descrição do perfil

Responsável por analisar e interpretar grandes quantidades de dados de uma variedade de fontes, usando ferramentas algorítmicas, de mineração de dados, inteligência artificial, aprendizado de máquina e estatísticas, a fim de torná-los acessíveis à empresa.



Principais atividades

- Identificar, coletar, preparar, validar, analisar e interpretar dados relativos às várias atividades da organização para extrair informações, inclusive através do desenvolvimento de modelos preditivos e estatísticos para gerar sistemas avançados de aprendizagem e conhecimento organizado;

- Identificar e acessar as fontes de dados capazes de apoiar e desenvolver um determinado processo de negócios;

- Desenvolver protótipos e proof of concept em projetos de inovação utilizando ferramentas de desenvolvimento ágil;

- Supervisionar a inovação tecnológica e promover a sua aplicação através da elaboração de relatórios de prospecção tecnológica e análise de oportunidades, destacando as alternativas;

- Definir e aplicar modelos de análise de dados descritivos, preditivos e prescritivos com base nas necessidades de aplicação definidas;

- Identificar interpretar e manipular os conjuntos de dados necessários para o desenvolvimento dos modelos;

- Promover a aplicação de técnicas de aprendizado de máquina estatísticas corretas;

- Contribuir na disseminação de uma cultura de Data-Driven Decision na cia, fazendo interface entre áreas técnicas e as diversas áreas de negócio;

- Extrair e organizar dados de inúmeras fontes e transformá-los em informações úteis e decifráveis por meio de gráficos e dashboards.



Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

- Codificação de programas e aplicações

- Algoritmos de Machine learning e frameworks como: TensorFlow, Pytorch, Sci-Kit Learn, Keras, H2O etc);

- Linguagens de programação (SQL, Shell Script, R, Pyhton, Scala, Java, etc.)

- Data Mining

- Database management

- Conhecimento de soluções de dados em Cloud (GCP, Azure, OCI, etc)

- Ensino superior completo

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

title: AI Gateway Engineer
description:
AI Gateway Engineer

We are seeking a skilled AI Gateway Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AI or API gateways, a strong background in backend development, and expertise in deploying and optimizing AI/ML models in a production environment. You will be instrumental in building and scaling our AI infrastructure within an enterprise-grade setting.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and manage AI/API gateways like Kong, Mosaic, or Portkey.
  • Develop and maintain backend services, primarily using Go , with Python as a valuable secondary skill.
  • Optimize and productize AI/ML models for production use, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Leverage AWS to build and manage our cloud infrastructure.
  • Implement and manage observability tools, including OpenTelemetry (OTel), Grafana, and Prometheus , to monitor system health and performance.
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of AI models.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and deployment of AI solutions.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Proven experience with API or AI gateways (e.g., Kong, Mosaic, Portkey).
  • Strong backend development skills, particularly in Go ; proficiency in Python is a plus.
  • Experience with AI/ML optimization and productization .
  • Expertise in AWS , including its various services for building scalable applications.
  • Familiarity with observability tools like OTel, Grafana, and Prometheus.
  • Practical experience with prompt engineering .
  • A history of working in enterprise-grade environments .


Other Details:
  • Location: Remote (preferred in LATAM region)
  • Length: 1+ Year

title: AWS Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

title: Mid/Senior Vue.js Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re seeking a Frontend Engineer to help us build intuitive, performant, and modern user experiences with Vue.js and TypeScript . You’ll have the opportunity to work closely with talented engineers and designers, turning ideas into high-quality digital products that impact thousands of users.


What you will do :

  • Develop responsive and elegant web applications using Vue.js and TypeScript.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and improve data flow.
  • Translate design mockups into reusable and scalable components.
  • Continuously optimize applications for performance and accessibility.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and a great user experience on all devices.
  • Participate in code reviews and actively contribute to the team’s technical growth.


What we expect from you :

Mid-level:

  • Strong experience with Vue.js and its ecosystem (Vuex, Vue Router, etc.).
  • Solid knowledge of TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and working with version control (Git).
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Playwright).
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Senior-level:

  • Proven expertise in Vue.js and TypeScript, delivering complex and scalable frontends.
  • Ability to make architectural decisions and lead UI performance improvements.
  • Strong UX awareness and experience collaborating with design teams.
  • Experience mentoring and supporting junior engineers.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.


Buscamos um Abap Sênior para atuação em cliente Atos de forma remota:

Abap Classico

SEGW/oData

title: Consultor SAP MM/WM (AMS)
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidade:

  • Consultor(a) para compor o time de AMS da NTT DATA realizando atendimento de chamados de sustentação e melhorias nos módulos MM/WM.


Requisitos:

  • Formação Superior Completo
  • Experiência como Consultor Pleno MM e WM.
  • Desejável conhecimento do EWM.
  • Experiência com implementação e/ou suporte AMS.
  • Inglês Avançado - Desejável


Formato de Trabalho: Remoto

Tipo de contrato: CLT


Garantimos que nossos funcionários sejam bem tratados, oferecendo pacotes de remuneração específicos para cada país, programas de reconhecimento e benefícios de prevenção. Dessa forma, incentivamos nossos colaboradores a terem o melhor desempenho e a comemorarem suas conquistas.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.
